title: Newquay OS map worksheet with six questions and key
subject: Geography
source: Seeded from geography/y8 lesson 6 (Newquay OS map worksheet with six questions and key (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 6: What do we use the coast for? Newquay on an OS map (4.4, 4.5). To understand how people use the coast and how to read it on an OS map

questions.q: Name one conflict between coastal users in Newquay.
questions.a: For example: more holiday homes vs local people needing affordable housing
questions.model: Pick two users: tourists and residents. What each wants: more holiday lets vs affordable homes. That is a conflict.

questions.q: What does a tent symbol on an OS map show?
Why do surfers like Fistral Beach?
questions.a: It faces the Atlantic and gets big waves from a long fetch

questions.q: Core: On the Newquay OS extract worksheet, answer six questions using symbols and six-figure grid references.
questions.model: Teacher does question 1: find the harbour, read the eastings then northings, estimate tenths, write the six figures.

questions.q: Extend: In the portal response box, explain one conflict and suggest a compromise.
questions.a: For example: limit new holiday lets and build affordable homes for local people, so tourism and residents both benefit

questions.q: Stretch: How does tourism bring both benefits and problems to Newquay?
questions.a: Benefits: jobs and income; problems: traffic, litter, seasonal jobs, high house prices

questions.q: Big question: who should get the most say over how a coast is used?
questions.a: Reasoned view balancing residents, businesses, visitors and nature
